title: Services
hero: Backend development built to last. Laravel and WordPress work from an engineer who plans past launch day.
intro: I help businesses and teams build backend systems that keep working once real traffic and real users show up. I have spent 6+ years working with PHP, Laravel and WordPress. I care about the parts of a project that matter most after launch, like speed, structure and long term upkeep. Below are the main services I offer. Each one uses the same approach. Understand the problem first, then build something that can grow with the business.

offers.title: Custom Software Solutions
offers.text: Tailored software built around exactly what your business needs, instead of what an off-the-shelf product forces you into.

offers.title: Laravel and PHP Development
offers.text: Custom Laravel applications, APIs and admin panels built with a strong foundation so they can grow without breaking.

offers.title: WordPress Development
offers.text: Custom plugins, themes and clean WordPress builds for teams that have outgrown a simple page builder.

background: I have worked on 29 projects and hold 22 certifications across backend development and related fields. You can see examples of past work on my Resume page and view my full list of certifications on the Certifications page.
whyWorkWithMe: I have spent 6+ years focused mainly on backend engineering. I am not someone who touches the backend now and then. I think about data, structure and growth first. I write code that is easy for someone else, or future me, to pick up later. I work across Laravel and WordPress depending on what each project actually needs, instead of forcing every project into the same tool.

faq.a: I offer custom software solutions, Laravel and PHP development, and WordPress development. This covers tailored business software, custom backend systems, APIs, admin panels, plugins, themes and content infrastructure.

faq.q: How do I choose the right service for my project?
faq.a: If you need a system built around a specific business process that does not fit existing tools, custom software solutions is usually the right fit. If you need a custom application or API built from scratch, Laravel and PHP is a strong choice. If you already use WordPress or want a content heavy site, WordPress development is a good match. If you are not sure, reach out and I can help you decide.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside Pakistan?
faq.a: Yes. I work remotely with clients in different countries and time zones.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: This depends on the size and scope of the project. A small plugin or feature may take a couple of weeks. A full application or CMS setup can take a few months. I can give a clear timeline once I understand the project.

cta: Not sure which service fits your project? Let us talk about it.

services.title: Custom Software Solutions
services.metaDescription: Custom software development tailored to your exact business needs. Systems, tools and platforms designed around your workflows instead of generic templates.
services.hero: Software built around your actual needs, not a template. Systems designed for the way your business works, not the other way around.
services.overview: Not every business problem fits neatly into an off-the-shelf product. Custom software is for the parts of your business that need to work the way you do. I take the time to understand how your team actually operates, then build a system that fits that workflow. This could be a tool that replaces a messy spreadsheet process, a portal that connects customers to your services, or a platform that automates a repetitive part of your operation. Whatever the problem, the goal is the same. Software that does the job well today and is easy to change as your business grows.
whatIBuild: Business tools and portals built around your exact workflow
Web applications that replace manual or spreadsheet based processes
Member, client and customer management systems
Automation that removes repetitive manual work
Integration between the tools your business already uses
Systems built on PHP, Laravel or WordPress, whichever fits best
services.howIWork: I start with the problem, not the technology. We talk through how your business works today, where the friction is, and what you want the end result to feel like. Only then do I decide on the stack. I build in stages and keep you in the loop, so there are no surprises at the end. When it is live, you get software that fits how your team works, with room to grow.
services.whyItMatters: Off-the-shelf tools make you adapt to them. Custom software adapts to you. That means fewer workarounds, less manual data entry, and a system your team actually wants to use. Because it is built around your process from day one, it is also cheaper to maintain and easier to extend later than forcing a generic product to fit.

faq.q: When does custom software make sense?
faq.a: When an existing tool almost works but not quite, or when your team is spending too much time on manual workarounds. If the cost of those workarounds keeps growing, a tailored system usually pays for itself.

faq.q: Can you work around the tools we already use?
faq.a: Yes. I often build systems that connect to existing software instead of replacing it, so your team does not have to learn everything from scratch.

faq.q: How do you decide which technology to build with?
faq.a: I pick based on the problem. Laravel for solid application backends, WordPress for content heavy builds, or a custom headless CMS when that is the right fit. The decision follows the project, not the other way around.

faq.q: What if my needs change after launch?
faq.a: That is expected. Custom software is built to change. Because it is written around your process, adding new features or adjusting existing ones is straightforward rather than a fight with the tool.

services.cta: Have a process that needs its own software? Let us talk.

services.title: Laravel and PHP Development
services.metaDescription: Custom Laravel and PHP backend development. Scalable APIs, admin panels and application structure built to handle real traffic without breaking.
services.hero: I build backend systems that keep working once real users show up. Clean structure, fast queries and code that does not fall apart six months later.
services.overview: PHP and Laravel have been the core of my work for more than 6 years. I use them to build custom APIs, admin panels and full application backends. These are the kinds of systems that need to stay fast and stable as traffic and complexity grow. I do not like putting together something that works today and breaks under load next month. I think through the structure first. How data moves, where slow points will show up, and what happens once this system is actually being used by real people.
whatIBuild: Custom Laravel applications built from the ground up
REST APIs for web, mobile and other third party tools
Admin panels and internal tools for teams
Database design and query tuning using MySQL
Caching with Redis to keep things fast at scale
Updating and rebuilding older PHP codebases
Connecting third party services and payment tools
services.howIWork: I start by understanding what the application actually needs to do. Not just a list of features, but how it will be used and where it needs to grow. From there I plan the database and the API structure before writing any application code. This means the foundation is solid and easy to build on later. I also test each part as I build it, instead of waiting until the end to see if everything fits together.
services.whyItMatters: Many backend problems do not show up right away. Slow queries under real data, code that is hard to extend, systems that were never built for the traffic they eventually get. I plan for these problems from day one so you are not paying to fix them later. A well built backend also makes it easier and cheaper to add new features down the road.

faq.q: Why should I choose Laravel over other PHP frameworks?
faq.a: Laravel comes with a lot of built in tools for common tasks like authentication, routing and database work. This means less time spent building basic pieces from scratch and more time spent on what makes your application different.

faq.q: Can you work with an existing Laravel or PHP project?
faq.a: Yes. I often step into projects that already exist, whether that means adding new features, fixing performance problems or cleaning up older code.

faq.q: Do you build both the API and the admin panel?
faq.a: Yes. I can build the full backend, including the API that powers your app or website and the admin panel your team uses to manage it.

faq.q: What if my current PHP code is old and hard to maintain?
faq.a: I can review the code, plan a path to update it safely, and rebuild the parts that need the most work without breaking what already works for your users.

services.cta: Have a Laravel or PHP project in mind? Let us talk.

services.title: WordPress Development
services.metaDescription: Custom WordPress development. Plugins, themes and clean, maintainable sites for teams that need more than a page builder can offer.
services.hero: Custom plugins, clean builds and WordPress sites that do not slow down or break as your content and traffic grow.
services.overview: I build WordPress sites and plugins the same way I build everything else. Speed and long term upkeep come first, not as an afterthought. This could mean a custom plugin built for one specific business need, a theme built from scratch, or fixing up a site that has grown past what a page builder can handle. My focus is always on making sure the site stays reliable as it grows.
whatIBuild: Custom WordPress plugins built for specific business needs
Custom themes built for speed, not just looks
API connections linking WordPress to other systems
Moving sites away from page builders to clean, custom code
Speed improvements for busy, high traffic WordPress sites
services.howIWork: Most WordPress problems come from using the wrong tool for the job. A stack of five plugins doing the work of one, or a theme that fights you every time you try to change something. I start by figuring out what the site actually needs. Sometimes that means one small custom plugin instead of five bloated ones. Sometimes it means a full custom theme built around your content and your users.
services.whyItMatters: A slow, cluttered WordPress site costs you visitors and, over time, money. I build sites that load fast because they are built lean, and that stay easy to manage because they were planned that way from day one. This also makes future updates simpler and cheaper.

faq.q: Do you build custom themes or use existing ones?
faq.a: Both, depending on your goals. If you need something unique to your brand and content, a custom theme is usually the better choice. If a solid existing theme fits your needs, I can adjust and extend it instead.

faq.q: Can you fix a slow WordPress site?
faq.a: Yes. I look at what is slowing the site down, whether that is plugins, hosting, images or the theme itself, and fix the parts that matter most.

faq.q: Do you build custom plugins for specific business needs?
faq.a: Yes. If your business has a process that does not fit into an existing plugin, I can build one that matches exactly what you need.

faq.q: Will my WordPress site be easy for my team to manage after launch?
faq.a: Yes. I build with your team in mind, so content updates and everyday changes do not require a developer every time.

services.cta: Need a WordPress build that can actually grow with you? Let us talk.
